items.title: Business support funding announced across Nova Scotia
items.regionEvidence: Release describes a province-wide program and lists nine regional delivery partners, including Halifax Partnership.
items.summary: The Province announced $1.48 million for a program connecting businesses with nine regional delivery partners. The announcement lists Halifax Partnership among the funded organizations.
